news.words: 49ers head coach Kyle Shanahan said after Sunday's game that running back Christian McCaffrey suffered a potential season-ending PCL injury in his knee.
Christian McCaffrey may be done for the rest of 2024. Shanahan told reporters in his postgame press conference that McCaffrey suffered a PCL injury that could be season-ending.

news.source: RotoWire via CBS (citing Ian Rapoport, NFL Network)
news.words: Head coach Kyle Shanahan said after Sunday's loss to the Bills that McCaffrey (knee) suffered a PCL injury in the contest that may be season-ending.

news.source: Kyle Shanahan, postgame press conference (Nick Wagoner, ESPN, via ABC7)
news.words: "I think potentially (it's season-ending). I think PCL is usually a couple weeks, but I'm not exactly sure yet." McCaffrey is slated to undergo further testing Monday.

news.source: RotoWire via CBS (citing Ian Rapoport, NFL Network)
news.words: Head coach Kyle Shanahan said Monday that McCaffrey is headed to injured reserve and is expected to need at least six weeks to recover from the PCL injury.

McCaffrey is being placed on injured reserve due to a PCL injury. Shanahan added that it won't require surgery and he will miss at least six weeks. With five weeks left, he would return only for a playoff run.
